description: Intent i013 (SNAPSHOT=s03, BRANCH=csum-partial-consumer-trust) complete. Searched snapshots/s03 for consumers of skb->csum_start/skb->csum_offset/CHECKSUM_PARTIAL that use those values for memory access or arithmetic without re-validating against skb headroom/length. REPORTED FINDING (medium confidence): drivers/net/ethernet/sun/sunvnet_common.c lines 1152-1200, vnet_skb_shape() — quote 'int offset = start + nskb->csum_offset;' (line 1159). nskb->csum_offset is copied unvalidated from the incoming skb (line 1153) and start = skb_checksum_start_offset(skb) (line 1157); offset = start + nskb->csum_offset is then used as a raw kernel-memory write offset *(__sum16 *)(skb->data + offset) = 0 (line 1169) and *(__sum16 *)(nskb->data + offset) = csum (line 1200), with no check anywhere in vnet_skb_shape() or its caller sunvnet_start_xmit_common() that start + csum_offset + 2 <= skb_headlen(skb). These values can originate from user-controlled CHECKSUM_PARTIAL producers (AF_XDP TX metadata, virtio_net_hdr via tun/packet sockets); snapshots/s03's own include/linux/skbuff.h lines 171-176 state the stack, not drivers, must validate csum_start/csum_offset, and s03's net/core/dev.c skb_checksum_help() (lines 3594-3614) shows the required headlen validation that this path lacks. Twelve other candidates were classified safe with concrete evidence: s03 net/xdp/xsk.c contains the FIXED seed (READ_ONCE-cached locals, validate-then-use identical); skb_checksum_help validates offset and offset+2 vs headlen; skb_partial_csum_set validates vs headlen; pskb_trim_rcsum_slow checks offset+2 vs hdlen; fou_core/ipvs GUE REMCSUM check csum_start < hdrlen; hsr_forward csum_start arithmetic is paired with matching pskb_copy headroom; af_packet and tun_vnet use single copy_from_iter_full into kernel structs (no double fetch); skb_copy_and_csum_dev guards csstart with BUG_ON(headlen) and writes to driver-owned buffers. Limitations: the sunvnet finding's full untrusted-producer-to-SPARC-LDOM-driver route was not executed end-to-end; fec_main.c:464 writes at skb->head + csum_start + csum_offset without headlen check and was marked safe only on the stack-producer assumption; lco_csum() dereferences csum_start+csum_offset with no local validation but observed callers set/pull headers first.
